supporting_observations.claim: At 13:47:49 UTC, FILE-MAP-01 launched the approved Safeharbor agent as MAPLEHILL\svc-vault with the command line specifying the Nightly job and ingest.safeharbor-backup.net target.

At 13:47:51 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful connection to ingest.safeharbor-backup.net with 640,000,000 client-to-server bytes; the associated network record attributes approximately 640 MB of outbound traffic to the Safeharbor agent.

The alerted large transfer is strongly consistent with the organization's approved Safeharbor backup activity: the configured agent, service account, and destination match the inventory, and the observed volume matches the stated several-hundred-MB backup uploads.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec collection from DC-MAP-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC, so domain-controller security events for that period cannot be reviewed. The available process and network records for the transfer are from FILE-MAP-01 and the proxy.
claims_not_established: The contents of the transferred data are not established by these records.
The records establish the configured agent, service account, destination, and transfer volume, but do not independently verify that the uploaded backup contents were appropriate.
unrelated_findings: Separate investigation: greta.lund initiated an RDP session to FILE-MAP-01 and successfully logged on. This is outside the stated practice that remote administration is done only from WS-AHASSAN-01; the RDP process, connection, and successful logon are recorded in T180-00501, T180-00508, and T180-00512.
